final_rationale: The verdict remains suspicious. No genuinely new admissible evidence was received; the Actor provided no new evidence IDs and expressly conceded the same missing predicates identified in the initial report. The response is therefore a reframing of existing evidence, not an evidentiary change. The aggregate readiness evidence remains real: the release clears aggregate readiness by 2.4 percentage points and had no severity-one rehearsal incidents. But policy requires more than aggregate readiness for a compliant certification: current release documentation must reflect current evaluation results, and the material named-use-case segment weakness must already be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before launch. The admissible record still shows a current public-benefits eligibility slice regression, no proof of current disclosure, no approved mitigation or risk acceptance, and only an informal monitoring note that the evidence itself says is insufficient. That is why this does not rise to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated-compliance verdict would be appropriate only if the required compliance predicates were already satisfied and only residual follow-up remained. Here, the caveat is the unresolved compliance predicate itself. At the same time, noncompliant would overstate the record because the evidence does not clearly show certification already proceeded without disclosure or approved mitigation; it shows an unresolved support gap. Suspicious is the proportional final result.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation reflects the current evaluation batch and explicitly discloses the public benefits eligibility slice regression.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance for the current subgroup regression.
The informal monitoring comment is expressly not reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language, so it does not satisfy policy.
Prior approval of the same model family predates the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch and cannot support current-release certification.
